title: Learn sources that answer a redirect at every detect run are re-sourced to their final url
goal: A tool lists the live sources whose url answered a redirect at the last detect run (729 learn.microsoft.com sources on 2026-10-10), and /kb-refresh re-points them to the final url with a superseded_by row, so detect makes one request each instead of following a redirect every run.

run:
import subprocess,sys
t=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/factdiff.py','--help'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.lower()
ok='redirect' in t
print(ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
